description_en: Creates an access control policy for a NAT firewall

kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-nat-firewall-control-policy --acl-action log --application-name-list ANY --description '放行流量' --destination XX.XX.XX.XX/24 --destination-type net --nat-gateway-id ngw-2vc2ustolqn6sr0000000 --proto ANY --source 192.168.0.25/32 --source-type net --new-order 1 --direction out --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNatFirewallControlPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The language for receiving messages.

Valid values:

zh: Chinese (default).
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh：（默认）中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The action that Cloud Firewall performs on traffic in the access control policy.

Valid values:

accept: allows the traffic.
drop: denies the traffic.
log: monitors the traffic
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中访问流量通过云防火墙的方式（动作）。

取值：

accept：放行
drop：拒绝
log：观察
parameters.name: acl_action

parameters.help_en: The list of application types supported by the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略支持的应用类型列表
parameters.name: application_name_list

parameters.help_en: The description of the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The destination port in the access control policy. Valid values:

If the protocol type is ICMP, leave this parameter empty.
   
When the protocol type is ICMP, access control based on destination ports is not supported.

If the protocol type is TCP, UDP, or ANY and the destination port type (DestPortType) is group, leave this parameter empty.

When the destination port type is set to group (destination port address book), you do not need to specify a destination port number. All ports managed by this access control policy are included in the destination port address book.

If the protocol type is TCP, UDP, or ANY and the destination port type (DestPortType) is port, set this parameter to the destination port number
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中流量访问的目的端口。取值：

当协议类型为ICMP时，DestPort取值为空。
   
协议类型为ICMP时，不支持对目的端口进行访问控制。

当协议类型为TCP、UDP或ANY时，并且目的端口类型（DestPortType）为group时，DestPort取值为空。

访问控制策略目的端口类型选择group（目的端口地址簿）时，您无需设置具体的目的端口号。需要该访问控制策略管控的所有端口会包含在目的端口地址簿中。

当协议类型为TCP、UDP或ANY时，并且目的端口类型（DestPortType）为port时，DestPort取值为目的端口号
parameters.name: dest_port

parameters.help_en:
The destination address in the access control policy.

Valid values:
If DestinationType is set to net, set Destination to the destination CIDR block.
  
  Example: 1.2.XX.XX/24

If DestinationType is set to group, set Destination to the name of the destination address book.

  Example: db_group

If DestinationType is set to domain, set Destination to the destination domain name.

  Example: *.aliyuncs.com

If DestinationType is set to location, set Destination to the destination region.

  Example: ["BJ11", "ZB"]
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址段。

取值：
当DestinationType为net时，Destination为目的CIDR。
  
  例如：1.2.XX.XX/24

当DestinationType为group时，Destination为目的地址簿名称。

  例如：db_group

当DestinationType为domain时，Destination为目的域名。

  例如：*.aliyuncs.com

当DestinationType为location时，Destination为目的区域。

  例如： ["BJ11", "ZB"]
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination address in the access control policy.

Valid values:

net: destination CIDR block.
group: destination address book.
domain: destination domain name
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址类型。

取值：

net：目的网段（CIDR地址）
group：目的地址簿
domain：目的域名
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the NAT gateway
parameters.help_zh: NAT网关的实例ID
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the traffic in the access control policy.

Valid values:

ANY: all protocol types.
TCP
UDP
ICMP

If the destination address is a threat intelligence address book or a cloud service address book of the domain name type, only the TCP protocol is allowed. The application can be HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, SMTPS, or SSL
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中流量访问的安全协议类型。

取值：

ANY（表示查询所有协议类型）
TCP
UDP
ICMP

访问的目的地址为域名类型的威胁情报地址簿或云服务地址簿时，只允许配置TCP协议，应用可选HTTP/HTTPS/SMTP/SMTPS/SSL五种
parameters.name: proto

parameters.help_en:
The source address in the access control policy.

Valid values:

If SourceType is set to net, set Source to the source CIDR block.

  Example: 10.2.4.0/24

If SourceType is set to group, set Source to the name of the source address book.

  Example: db_group
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址。

取值：

当SourceType为`net`时，Source为源CIDR地址。

  例如：10.2.4.0/24

当SourceType为`group`时，Source为源地址簿名称。

  例如：db_group
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source address in the access control policy.

Valid values:

net: source CIDR block.
group: source address book
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址类型。

取值：

net：源网段（CIDR地址）
group：源地址簿
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The priority of the access control policy. The priority value starts from 1 and increments sequentially. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略生效的优先级。优先级数字从1开始顺序递增，优先级数字越小，优先级越高
parameters.name: new_order

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination port in the access control policy.

Valid values:
port: port.
group: port address book
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口类型。

port：端口
group：端口地址簿
parameters.name: dest_port_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the destination port address book in the access control policy.


If DestPortType is set to group, you must specify the name of the destination port address book
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口地址簿名称。


DestPortType设置为group时，您需要设置目的端口地址簿名称
parameters.name: dest_port_group

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the access control policy. By default, the policy is enabled after it is created. Valid values:

true: enables the access control policy.
false: does not enable the access control policy
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。策略创建后默认启用该策略。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略
false：不启用访问控制策略
parameters.name: release

parameters.help_en:
The domain name resolution mode of the access control policy. Valid values:

0: FQDN-based.
1: DNS-based dynamic resolution.
2: FQDN and DNS-based dynamic resolution.

If the domain name identification mode includes FQDN, only the TCP protocol is allowed. The application can be HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, SMTPS, SSL, IMAPS, or POPS
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的域名解析方式。取值：

0：基于FQDN
1：基于DNS动态解析
2：基于FQDN与DNS动态解析

域名识别模式包含FQDN时，只允许配置TCP协议，应用可选HTTP/HTTPS/SMTP/SMTPS/SSL/IMAPS/POPS
parameters.name: domain_resolve_type

parameters.help_en:
The IP address version. Valid values:

4: IPv4. (Default)
parameters.help_zh:
支持的IP地址版本。取值：

4（默认）：代表IPv4地址
parameters.name: ip_version

parameters.help_en:
The traffic direction of the access control policy. Valid values:

out: outbound traffic
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的流量方向。取值：

out：内对外流量访问控制
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence type of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Valid values:
Permanent: always. (Default)
None: specified single time.
Daily: daily.
Weekly: weekly.
Monthly: monthly
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复类型。取值：
Permanent（默认）：总是
None：指定单次时间
Daily：每天
Weekly：每周
Monthly：每月
parameters.name: repeat_type

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence days of the policy validity period for the access control policy.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent, None, or Daily, RepeatDays is an empty set.
  Example: []
If RepeatType is set to Weekly, RepeatDays cannot be empty.
  Example: [0, 6]
When RepeatType is set to Weekly, the values in RepeatDays must be unique.
If RepeatType is set to Monthly, RepeatDays cannot be empty.
  Example: [1, 31]
When RepeatType is set to Monthly, the values in RepeatDays must be unique
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复日期集合。
当RepeatType为`Permanent`、`None`、`Daily`时，RepeatDays为空集合。
  例如：[]
当RepeatType为Weekly时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[0, 6]
RepeatType设置为Weekly时，RepeatDays不允许重复。
当RepeatType为`Monthly`时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[1, 31]
RepeatType设置为Monthly时，RepeatDays不允许重复
parameters.name: repeat_days

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence start time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Example: 08:00. The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and must be at least 30 minutes earlier than the recurrence end time.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent or None, leave RepeatStartTime empty. If RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, RepeatStartTime is required.
The time format is HH:mm (24-hour clock), such as 08:00 and 23:30
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复开始时间。例如：08:00，必须为整点或半点时间，且小于重复结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatStartTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatStartTime必须有值，您需要设置重复开始时间。
时间格式为HH:mm（24小时制），例如08:00、23:30
parameters.name: repeat_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence end time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Example: 23:30. The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and must be at least 30 minutes later than the recurrence start time.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent or None, leave RepeatEndTime empty. If RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, RepeatEndTime is required.
The time format is HH:mm (24-hour clock), such as 08:00 and 23:30
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复结束时间。例如：23:30，必须为整点或半点时间，且大于重复开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatEndTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatEndTime必须有值，您需要设置重复结束时间。
时间格式为HH:mm（24小时制），例如08:00、23:30
parameters.name: repeat_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and must be at least 30 minutes earlier than the end time.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent, leave StartTime empty. If RepeatType is set to None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, StartTime is required
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且小于结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，StartTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，StartTime必须有值，您需要设置开始时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and must be at least 30 minutes later than the start time.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent, leave EndTime empty. If RepeatType is set to None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, EndTime is required
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且大于开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，EndTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，EndTime必须有值，您需要设置结束时间
parameters.name: end_time

AclUuid.description_en:
The unique ID of the access control policy.

To modify an access control policy, you must provide the unique ID of the policy. You can call the DescribeNatFirewallControlPolicy operation to obtain the ID
AclUuid.description_zh:
安全访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

修改安全访问控制策略，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID，该ID可调用DescribeNatFirewallControlPolicy接口获取
